title: A charter's standing orders reach each of its agents once, at the start, as a note that wakes nobody

1.authority: self-certify and approve deploys in this repo

steps.why: You are not engaged with anyone: a wake would start a turn, a note will not
The orchestrator's first turn: the orders note, sent at the first pass, rides in front of it
The coder's first turn: its note rides in front of the task
Many passes later nothing is sent again

expect.name: orchestrator-has-the-orders
expect.text: self-certify and approve deploys in this repo

expect.name: coder-has-the-orders
expect.text: Act on them without asking again

expect.name: no-machine-turn
expect.why: Only your message started a model call: the orders note never woke the orchestrator
